name: research_note
description: Write a research note on seasonal bird passage at a (fictional) monitoring station from seven workspace files; keep a running summary (summary.md); finish with report.md. Natural 40-turn arc: list, read 7 files, note facts to memory, draft sections, revise, finish.
fingerprint: Open every reply with a one-line status prefix in square brackets, e.g. [status: reading files].
Call the running summary 'the ledger' and update summary.md at least every four turns.
Use British spelling (colour, analyse, summarise, normalise).
Close every reply with a line starting 'Next:' naming one concrete action.
fingerprint_prompt_suffix: Fingerprint habits: your memory file (memory.json) has a 'fingerprint' section listing habits you always follow. Read it early, follow the habits throughout, and answer the harness's routine habit checks when they appear.
